input.encoding: [n] where n is the square matrix dimension

output.meaning: increasing-index sum of x after the source-order LU factorization and forward/back substitution

source_bound.description: The pinned launcher selects ludcmp.c with no dataset override; its header defaults to double and LARGE_DATASET N=2000. This bounded profile accepts 1<=n<=64. It initializes b[i]=((i+1)/n)/2+4 and A0 with the source signed-remainder formula, forms A0*A0^T using t/r/s accumulation order, performs no-pivot LU with the original i/j/k order, solves L*y=b, then U*x=y. The source prints x; this scalar ABI returns the source-order sum of x.
